AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  DECEMBER 14, 2022
  UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
 ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A
 REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
 MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN
 THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-(669) 444-9171 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 929 283
  6465# DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS
CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
  hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner
 Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
 other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
 Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
 Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
 the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
 not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
 certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
 after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated December 8, 2022.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary

  DECEMBER 14, 2022
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF ASSEMBLY
BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION
WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND
THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-(669)
444-9171 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 929 283 6465# DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM.
THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY’S WEBPAGE
AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  6:00 P.M.

  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner

 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: planning@norwalkca.gov, or through the
 video/teleconference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction subject to the
 rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency
 or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration
 at a future Planning Commission meeting.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
 services offered by this City, please contact the Community Development Department, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening devices are
 available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda
 packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the
 meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
 accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda after it has
 been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection, by request in the Community Development Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
 Boulevard during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday; telephone (562) 929-5744. You may also contact
 the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
  Planning Commission Synopsis, December 14, 2022
  Page 1 of 2
 CALL TO ORDER  6:00 P.M.
FLAG SALUTE  Commissioner Navas
ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS  Commissioner Apodaca, Commissioner Garcia, Commissioner
  Navas, Vice Chair Lopez and Chair Barragan

NEW BUSINESS

1. REORGANIZATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  Chair:  Rosa Barragan
  Vice Chair: Linda Lopez

2. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes
  of the Special Meeting of September 14, 2022.
  Planning Commission Action: Approved.

PUBLIC HEARING

3. PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN NO. 2022-02
  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 3)
  Jerry Simmons, JRS Architecture (“Applicant”); a request to construct a new 9,600 square feet
  multi-tenant commercial building and associated site improvements. The subject property is
  generally known as 12241 Imperial Highway, located on the north side of Imperial Highway
  between Norwalk Boulevard and Volunteer Avenue (also known as Assessor’s Parcel Number
  (“APN”) 8025-023-900 and 8025-023-903), in the Specific Plan Area No. 8 zone.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 22-12 to approve
  Precise Development Plan No. 2022-02 subject to the Conditions of Approval contained in Exhibit
  “A”.
  Planning Commission Action: Approved staff’s recommendation by a vote of 4-1.

NEW BUSINESS

4. 6th CYCLE (2021-2029) HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission:
  • Provide additional input related to the Housing Element;
  • Receive and file this report.
  Planning Commission Action: Provided additional input and received and filed report.

5. ITEMS FROM STAFF (Oral Report)

  - Review Director Approval Requests (DARs) that have been processed by staff.
  - Provide update of ongoing projects.
  Planning Commission Action: Received and Filed Reports.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
The Planning Commissioners commented on various issues, including bringing requests for beer and wine
licenses for restaurants back for review by the Planning Commission; considering holding study sessions;
looking into green mesh fencing for vacant properties; addressing architectural standards; increasing the radius
for public hearing notices; that box signs are not being enforced; and addressing Planning Commission rules.
Chair Barragan wished everyone a Safe and Happy Holiday and all the best for 2023.

ADJOURNMENT  7:45 P.M.
